title: Water supply not detected
shortDescription: The TOTO Washlet or Neorest does not detect water flow from the supply.
fullDescription:
Err 1 on TOTO Washlet S550e, S500e and Neorest models indicates the fill solenoid opened but the flow sensor did not register water movement within the expected time.

Most often this is caused by a closed angle stop, a kinked supply hose, or a clogged inlet filter. Confirm water is on at the wall, then clean the inlet filter at the T-valve.

fixSteps.title: Open supply valve
fixSteps.instruction: Turn the angle stop fully counter-clockwise.

fixSteps.title: Clean T-valve filter
fixSteps.instruction: Shut off water, remove T-valve, rinse filter mesh.

whenToCallPro: If flow sensor replacement is required.

faq.a: Yes, use the manual flush lever at the back of the tank.

title: Water temperature sensor out of range
shortDescription: The instant-heat water thermistor reports a fault.
fullDescription:
Err 2 indicates the Washlet's instant water heater thermistor is reading outside valid range. The heater is disabled for safety and only ambient-temperature water is delivered.

This is typically a hardware fault requiring service. A power cycle may clear a transient reading.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug Washlet for 5 minutes and reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Contact TOTO service for heater assembly replacement.

faq.a: Yes, only warm water function is disabled.

title: Seat temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: Seat heater thermistor reports out-of-range value.
fullDescription: The heated seat thermistor is indicating a fault. Seat heat is disabled until the fault clears. Usually requires replacement of the seat assembly by TOTO service.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact TOTO service for seat replacement.

faq.a: Typically 1-2 weeks for service appointment and parts.

title: Wand position error
shortDescription: Cleansing wand cannot reach home or extend position.
fullDescription: Err 4 means the wand drive did not reach its expected position within step limits. Debris, scale, or a failed motor are the usual causes. Run self-clean and power cycle.

fixSteps.title: Self-clean
fixSteps.instruction: Hold clean on remote to exercise wand.

faq.a: In hard-water areas, yes — descale every 6 months.

title: Seat sensor fault
fullDescription: The Washlet uses a capacitive or pressure sensor to detect an occupant before enabling bidet operation. Err 5 indicates no valid signal or a short. Clean the seat contact area and power cycle.

fixSteps.title: Dry seat area
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe seat and hinge fully dry, especially underside contacts.

faq.q: Why does bidet need seat detect?

title: Dryer fan fault
shortDescription: Warm-air dryer fan not running or blocked.
fullDescription: Err 6 means the Washlet's warm-air dryer fan has stalled or is reporting low RPM. Dust accumulation in the intake grille is the most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Clean grille
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum the dryer intake at the side of seat.

faq.q: Can I use bidet without dryer?

title: Remote communication error
shortDescription: Remote control loses pairing with Washlet.
fullDescription: Err 7 indicates infrared or RF communication failure between remote and Washlet. Verify line of sight, replace batteries, and re-pair if needed.

fixSteps.title: Clear IR window
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe IR lens on remote and seat.

faq.a: Yes, use the side-body button panel.

title: Deodorizer fan fault
fullDescription: Err 8 is specific to Washlet models with carbon-filter deodorizer fans. The fan has stopped rotating, often due to a failed bearing or clogged filter. Replace the carbon filter and verify fan spins freely.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Order TOTO carbon deodorizer filter and replace per manual.

whenToCallPro: If filter replacement does not resolve.

title: Main PCB communication fault
shortDescription: Internal bus error between control boards.
fullDescription: Err 9 indicates the main PCB cannot reach a peripheral PCB over the internal communication bus. Usually resolved by a 5-minute power cycle; persistent Err 9 means a board replacement.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Contact TOTO service if Err 9 returns.

title: Moisture detected inside Washlet housing
shortDescription: Internal leak sensor has triggered and disabled water functions.
fullDescription:
Newer Washlets include a leak pan sensor under the heater block. If moisture is detected, the unit shuts the inlet solenoid and disables bidet spray to prevent damage.

Unplug, dry thoroughly, and contact TOTO service — this typically indicates a split hose or cracked heater tank.

fixSteps.title: Unplug
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect from outlet to avoid electrical hazard.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Contact TOTO service for leak diagnosis and repair.

faq.a: Often yes if within warranty period — contact TOTO.

title: Over-temperature shutdown
shortDescription: Water temperature exceeded safety threshold and heater was shut down.
fullDescription:
Neorest models monitor instant water heater output. If temperature rises above 50 C (122 F), heater output is latched off until a manual reset. This can be triggered by scale buildup acting as insulation in the heater tank.

Power cycle to reset. If repeating, descale the supply per TOTO maintenance procedure.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Run TOTO recommended descale routine or call service for flush.

title: Carbon deodorizer filter needs replacement
shortDescription: Runtime counter indicates carbon filter has reached end of useful life.
fullDescription:
Washlet tracks deodorizer fan operating hours and alerts when carbon filter capacity is depleted. The filter is a user-replaceable cartridge (TOTO THU9145).

Replacing the filter and resetting the counter via remote returns full odor-control performance.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Slide out carbon cartridge from side of Washlet and insert new TOTO filter.

fixSteps.title: Reset counter
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold the Filter button on remote until reminder clears.

faq.a: TOTO USA parts store or authorized plumbing suppliers.
